## 1. Shifokor Haqida (O'zbekcha)
Dr. Olimjon Tojibayev — 7 yillik amaliy tajribaga ega bo'lgan shifokor-stomatolog, dental implantolog va ortodont. U bemorlarni Andijon shahrida, ilg'or 3D uskunalar bilan jihozlangan "Smiles Dental Group" klinikasida shaxsan qabul qiladi.
Shifokorlik falsafasi: "Avval inson, keyin muolaja". Har bir bemorga noqulay gips qoliplarisiz 60 soniyali 3D skanerlash, 2 bosqichli og'riqsiz anesteziya va tabiiy tishlarni maksimal saqlab qolish imkoniyati taqdim etiladi.

## 2. О Враче (Русский)
Д-р Олимжон Тожибаев — врач-стоматолог, эксперт по дентальной имплантации и ортодонтии с 7-летним успешным клиническим стажем. Ведёт личный приём в г. Андижан на базе современной клиники Smiles Dental Group.
Врачебный принцип: сначала человек, затем лечение. Полное избавление пациентов от страха боли благодаря деликатной двухэтапной анестезии, высокоточному 3D интраоральному сканированию без неприятных слепков и бережному сохранению собственных зубов.

## 3. About the Doctor (English)
Dr. Olimjon Tojibayev is an experienced dental surgeon specializing in digital dentistry, dental implants, clear aligners, and aesthetic smile restoration in Andijan, Uzbekistan. Operating at Smiles Dental Group, Dr. Tojibayev prioritizes patient comfort, gentle two-stage micro-anesthesia, 60-second putty-free 3D optical scanning, and long-term clinical warranties.

---

## 4. Complete Services Catalog & Pricing Guidance

1. **Raqamli Stomatologiya / Цифровая Диагностика / 3D Digital Dentistry**
   - URL: https://drtojibayev.uz/services/digital-dentistry
   - Duration: 15–30 min
   - Key benefits: 60s optical scan, zero gag reflex, virtual 3D simulation.

2. **Dental Implantatsiya / Имплантация / Dental Implants**
   - URL: https://drtojibayev.uz/services/dental-implant
   - Materials: Premium biocompatible medical titanium
   - Duration: 15–20 min per implant under 2-stage anesthesia
   - Success rate: 99.6%

3. **Shaffof Elaynerlar / Элайнеры / Clear Aligners**
   - URL: https://drtojibayev.uz/services/elaynerlar
   - Duration: 6–18 months depending on case
   - Key benefits: Invisible, removable, comfortable eating and hygiene.

4. **Breket Tizimlari / Брекет-системы / Orthodontic Braces**
   - URL: https://drtojibayev.uz/services/breketlar
   - Types: Metal, ceramic, sapphire aesthetic brackets.

5. **Tsirkon Koronkalar / Циркониевые Коронки / Zirconia Crowns**
   - URL: https://drtojibayev.uz/services/tsirkon-keramika-koronka
   - Durability: 15–20+ years, biocompatible, natural tooth translucency.

6. **Keramik Vinirlar / Виниры / Ceramic Veneers**
   - URL: https://drtojibayev.uz/services/vinirlar
   - Thickness: 0.3–0.5 mm E-max press ceramics, stain-resistant.

7. **Tish Protezlari / Протезирование / Modern Dentures**
   - URL: https://drtojibayev.uz/services/protezlar
   - Types: Clasp (byugel), flexible nylon, durable acrylic.

8. **Og'riqsiz Terapiya / Терапия без боли / Painless Restorative Care**
   - URL: https://drtojibayev.uz/services/ogriqsiz-terapiya
   - Treatment: Caries, pulpitis, canal obturation, aesthetic filling.

9. **Professional Tish Oqartirish / Отбеливание / Teeth Whitening**
   - URL: https://drtojibayev.uz/services/tish-oqartirish
   - Effect: Up to 6–8 shades brighter with enamel remineralization.
